name: red-alert
description: Audible alerts for Claude Code: Claude sounds normal/yellow/red alerts on your server's speakers, with an LCARS status band and alert animations.

token.title: Daemon token
token.description: The daemon's server.token, if you set one.

pollSeconds.title: Health check interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the band checks whether the daemon is online and picks up alerts raised elsewhere.

permissionPromptLevel.title: Alert on permission prompts
permissionPromptLevel.description: Sound this level whenever Claude Code waits on a permission prompt, or 'off'.

idleBand.title: Show the status band
idleBand.description: Show the LCARS status strip above the prompt while no alert is up. Alerts always animate there.
